name: Solupac

about:
Solupac is based in North Miami, Florida, and was founded in 2004 as a third-generation family-owned business under the parent company Tradepro Inc. The company was established to address a market gap in packaging, and today operates with offices in North Miami and Colombia, along with company-owned production facilities in South America. Leadership includes CEO and Managing Member Carlos Zaher and Managing Member Steven Schmutter.

The company manufactures both generic and custom-printed plastic and paper packaging products. Its in-house capabilities span design, manufacturing, and supply chain management, supported by a warehouse in Miami and production plants in South America. The product line includes mailer bags, reusable bags, trash bags, kraft paper bags, paper cone cups, bath tissue, industrial packaging, shopping bags, ice bags, die-cut bags, draw tape bags, security bags, C-fold paper towels, silverware bags, kraft paper rolls, napkins, fertilizer bags, medical waste bags, stretch film, and polyethylene gloves.

Solupac serves customers across North America, Central America, and the Caribbean. While the company does not publicly list specific industry verticals, its product range indicates service to medical, agricultural, retail, and industrial sectors.

The company emphasizes sustainability through a circular economy approach, sourcing recycled raw materials via Tradepro Inc. and developing compostable polymers and 100% recycled kraft paper. Its differentiators include rapid turnarounds enabled by in-house design and customer care teams in North Miami and Colombia, and a legacy of over 20 years in the packaging industry.
